facts.text: Through the Carmen Twillie Ambar Sophomore Expedition, Cedar Crest College funds a short-term study abroad trip for all full-time traditional second-year students at no extra cost for travel, lodging, programming, or meals.

sources.title: Sophomore Expedition - Learn Abroad | Cedar Crest College
sources.quote: It offers all full-time, traditional, second-year students the opportunity to participate in a college-sponsored, short-term study abroad trip at no additional cost for travel, lodging, programming, or meals.
